correctness.rationale: The complete nine nonzero structure constants of the three separate products were reconstructed from the frozen model. Every double product vanishes since e2 annihilates both slots, validating the tridendriform identities. Building nine unknown matrix entries and all Leibniz equations independently yields exact rational constraint rank six and nullity three, with basis diag(1,2,1), E21, E23; matrix commutators are [H,U]=U,[H,V]=V,[U,V]=0. Characteristic zero is necessary for 2c=0 implying c=0. These calculations independently verify the full formula, not just existence of one nonzero derivation.
